processes.name: inference gateway
processes.description: A FastAPI service on GKE that receives inference requests and forwards them to the model server.
processes.source_excerpt: our inference gateway, a FastAPI service on GKE
processes.notes: API keys are issued per calling team and have never been expired.

processes.name: model server
processes.description: The server that runs the actual model on GPU nodes and reads model artifacts and customer features.
processes.source_excerpt: the model server, which runs the actual model on GPU nodes in our model network
processes.notes: The description says nothing verifies that a model artifact has not been swapped; it says the bucket is trusted.

data_stores.name: model registry bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket containing model artifacts loaded by the model server at startup.
data_stores.source_excerpt: model artifacts from a model registry bucket
data_stores.notes: The speaker says they do not believe anything verifies that an artifact has not been swapped and that they just trust the bucket.

data_stores.name: Redis feature store
data_stores.description: A Redis store containing customer features including account age and spend bands per customer.
data_stores.source_excerpt: a Redis feature store on the same network. ... The features include account age and spend bands per customer.

data_stores.name: inference log
data_stores.description: A BigQuery log containing every request and response for debugging, including raw prompts that may contain calling users' typed content.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The gateway writes every request and response into an inference log in BigQuery, for debugging.
data_stores.notes: The log contains raw prompts, which sometimes carry whatever the calling team's users typed.

data_flows.name: call gateway
data_flows.description: Other teams' backends send inference requests to the inference gateway.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Other teams' backends call our inference gateway

data_flows.name: forward request
data_flows.description: The inference gateway forwards requests to the model server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The gateway forwards the request to the model server
data_flows.notes: There is no authentication between the gateway and the model server.

data_flows.name: load artifacts
data_flows.description: The model server loads model artifacts from the model registry bucket at startup.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The model server loads model artifacts from a model registry bucket at startup.

data_flows.name: read features
data_flows.description: The model server reads customer features from the Redis feature store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the model server reads from a Redis feature store on the same network
data_flows.notes: Redis has no password and is only reachable inside the model network.
data_flows.data_description: Customer features, including account age and spend bands per customer

data_flows.name: write logs
data_flows.description: The inference gateway writes every request and response to the inference log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The gateway writes every request and response into an inference log in BigQuery
data_flows.data_description: Every request and response, including raw prompts

data_flows.name: publish artifacts
data_flows.description: ML engineers publish new model artifacts to the model registry bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: ML engineers publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket.
data_flows.notes: The speaker is unsure what governs who can push and thinks it is a shared group account.

trust_boundaries.name: internet
trust_boundaries.description: The externally reachable network from which calling services access the inference gateway.

trust_boundaries.name: GKE
trust_boundaries.description: The GKE hosting environment for the inference gateway.

trust_boundaries.description: The network containing the GPU nodes running the model server and the Redis feature store; it is intended to be reachable only from the gateway.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: the model network is meant to be reachable only from the gateway

trust_boundaries.name: product teams
trust_boundaries.description: The organisational environment associated with the product teams using the hosted model inference service.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Hosted model inference for our product teams.

trust_boundaries.name: hosted model inference
trust_boundaries.description: The overall hosted model inference system boundary for the model registry bucket and other elements whose specific zone is not stated.
